subject: Aboard the colony ship ariadne, in the bay where the work is being done. The reactor's coolant seals are perishing faster than the manual says they should, and every new one Roberta fits comes out of the spares that have to last forty years. Mac has been growing a resin off a fungus culture that sets like rubber in an hour. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
